name: Chrissy
houseDescription: Bright cute set with a festive, bouncy layout — birthday party that never ended.
description: Bubblegum peppy rabbit with starry eyes and boundless cheer—fans love her beside Francine for sister-island stories.

seo.title: Chrissy — Peppy rabbit
seo.description: Chrissy the peppy rabbit in Animal Crossing—starry-eyed energy and sister-island charm beside Francine.

acnh.appearance: Chrissy is a white rabbit in a pink polka-dot hood, blonde fringe peeking out, green nose, and pink blush on her cheeks. Two pink lashes sit low on each eye; black eyes hold white sparkles that flash pink when she is shocked. She mirrors Francine in silhouette — pink where her sister wears blue, different eyes — and wears a smile so often it feels like her default expression.
acnh.personality: Chrissy bubbles with peppy voltage — excitable, rarely discouraged, and always ready to bounce out of her house. She overreacts to tiny stakes, especially competitions; ask her about clothing or furniture and she may need something specific to enter one. Fossils fascinate her, and she often requests one for her collection because she loves the hunt. Pink, she insists, suits her best, and she says so often enough that neighbors smile and nod. Arguments with snooty villagers turn sharp; she may blame the player for tastes she dislikes and rage rather than sulk when cranky or snooty neighbors tease her. Jocks do not mock her eating habits — she keeps meals modest — but peppy openness still clashes with snooty barbs and name-calling. Jock, lazy, normal, and fellow peppy villagers tend to accept her open-minded cheer; cranky and snooty types stir drama she refuses to swallow quietly. Her attention span is short: unfinished tasks and old spats slip from memory fast, though she rarely stays discouraged from hobbies she loves. Stay friendly and she remains a starry-eyed neighbor who treats the island like a runway and a playground at once, forever smiling unless someone insults her favorite color.

villagerInfo.quote: A fool and their Bells are soon parted.
